utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Check them again, please. I’ll work from the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m happy to help keep the list clear and make sure everyone knows where they can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — let’s jot down the jobs first, then we can match each one with a helper and a time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive details tight and confirm any changes right away. If you have the location, timing, and repair list, send them my way and I’ll double-check everything before it goes out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s exactly right, Rosa — I’ll send the location, timing, and repair list, and we’ll keep it tight so we don’t overpromise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send the details when you have them, and I’ll make sure the group chat gets the clean, confirmed version.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the confirmed repairs, who’s handling each one, and the date for the drive. If any of that isn’t locked in yet, say so plainly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, I’m not sure those details are locked in yet. I can help, but I’d want to hear the confirmed list and date from whoever last said it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then please get me the confirmed list and date—no estimates. Tell me exactly who can verify it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I’ve been hearing that too — folks are bringing in tools and spare parts, and a few hands are already lined up to help. I’ll keep pointing people to the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, that’s the plan then — bring the tools and parts to the drop-off spot, and I’ll keep repeating the porch steps, fence gate, then the kitchen tap. Let’s keep it simple and moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the drop-off spot and the repair list, and I’ll only pass along what looks usable.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right — the community hall roof, if I’m remembering correctly. I’m not sure about the rest, but we should keep only the usable parts in mind.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes, that sounds right — the roof is definitely the big one people keep mentioning. I’ll keep it to the usable parts and check what’s actually confirmed before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s probably the safest way to handle it. I’d rather not guess at the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together from bits and pieces, but I can ask around and see if there’s a confirmed list of repairs and a date.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — keep to that and bring me a confirmed list with a finish date. I’d rather not change the plan once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and bring back a confirmed list and finish date.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep me posted with the gist, and I’ll stay on it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — just send me the next fix, and I’ll get it sorted this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll send the next fix when I’m free, and we’ll keep it rolling.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll recheck the list and send only the confirmed repairs, owners, dates, and costs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That sounds good—send the confirmed details and I’ll help fill in any gaps if needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll send the confirmed list first, and I’ll clearly mark anything that still needs verification.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got those noted, and I’ll keep the list as-is until I hear otherwise. If you remember any other missing supplies or commitments for the repair drive, tell me and I’ll add them carefully.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep checking the exact location, timing, and supply list so nothing slips. If anything else comes up, I’ll flag it right away before it goes to the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Opal — I’ll keep my list unchanged for now and wait for your updates before I write anything else down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m free from 12:30 to 2:00, but I need to leave by 2:10 for pickup. If the repair drive fits that window, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That should work — I think the repair drive can fit in that window, but I should double-check the latest details. I’ll ask around and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the exact time, and I can plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m ready to spread the word as soon as you’ve got the time and place pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I’ve got the time and place pinned down—just tell me the details, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — send me the time and place, and I’ll get it out neighborhood-wide right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’ve already noted the volunteers, packing tape, and label maker, and I’m ready to add anything else carefully.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — I’m still waiting on the written confirmation for the parts list, but I’ll pass it along as soon as it lands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Understood — I’ll keep the list as-is for now and wait for the written parts confirmation before I add anything new.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah — I’ve been hearing more people ask where to drop things off, so I’ll keep pointing them to the right spot. Sounds like the repair drive’s really picking up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — send me the exact drop-off location and time window, and I’ll make sure the details are locked in cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the latest and pass it along — I’ve heard folks are aiming for the usual community hall lot, but I want to confirm the exact window before I tell anyone for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the confirmed repairs, who’s responsible for each one, and any verified date or cost. If you don’t have it yet, just say so plainly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the confirmed repairs, responsible folks, or a verified date or cost yet. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m going to ask around and get back to you with the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Understood. Come back with the confirmed repairs, the person responsible for each, and any verified date or cost—nothing else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — what’s done, what’s left, and when do you want the repair drive finished?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m happy to help with the hands-on stuff—just send me the list of what’s left, and I can swing by this weekend. No need to pin down every detail yet, just point me at the next fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect — I’ll send you the next fix and keep it simple. If you can take the hands-on part this weekend, that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m ready to blast it neighborhood-wide as soon as you’ve got the time and place pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It was for the community hall roof, I think. I’m not certain on the rest, but that’s what I remember.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll spread that around as the community hall roof repair drive and ask folks to keep an eye out for the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: If you can keep it within 12:30 to 2:00, I can help — I just have to leave by 2:10 for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — let’s keep it within that window and stick to the plan. Just tell me what’s done, what’s left, and when it’ll be wrapped.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll keep it tight and let you know what’s done, what’s left, and when I’m wrapping up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah yes, the community hall roof — that sounds right. I’ll help however I can; just tell me where to meet and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just tell me where to meet, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, wherever you said last — I’ll meet you there and follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll recheck the latest repair details and send you only the confirmed list, with owners, dates, and costs clearly marked.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that sounds perfect. Once you send the confirmed list, I can match the jobs to people and times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify everything first, then send the confirmed list only, with any unconfirmed items clearly flagged.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works for me—keep me posted on the time and place, and I’ll help fill in the gaps where I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just send me the time and place, and I’ll roll with it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — once you’ve got the time and place, send it over and I’ll help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind too, but I think the repair drive still needs volunteers, packing tape, and a label maker. If you’ve heard any newer updates, I should probably catch up on them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m still in, and I’ll keep it simple when I spread the word. I’ll also make sure folks know where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps — I’m still a bit behind, so I’ll pass that along too. If anything changes on the repair drive, let me know and I’ll try to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—we’ll keep the repair drive tight and stick to the original plan. If Leo has the key pieces, I’ll help carry it forward without overpromising.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Keep to the plan, and I’ll bring the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — bring the latest list and I’ll keep us on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still need the parts list in writing and the source before I can sign off. Can you confirm that and send it over?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’ll confirm the parts list and source in writing, then send you the clean update right away. I’ll double-check it before it goes to the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I’ll wait for the written confirmation and source before signing off.
